name: Pitch Black
label: Revelation
lede: Pitch Black came out of Oakland with a keyboard player, a cowbell and two albums on Revelation, a label built on youth crew, and closed the second one with a song called Executives and Art Directors.

eras.title: Three hundred numbered copies
eras.text: Pitch Black started out of Oakland playing punk and rock and roll. A hand-numbered 7" on the local label Cheetah's Records got them going, and Revelation, by then well past its straight edge roots, put out the debut album.

years.h: A 7" on Cheetah's Records, numbered out of 300
years.p: Half Empty, Undefeated and No Leaders on black vinyl, each copy hand-numbered, with a lyric insert.

years.h: Cheetah's presses the Pitch Black 7" again, in blood red and orange
years.p: Once the 300 numbered copies of the first 7" are gone, the label runs a repress on colored vinyl.

years.h: Pitch Black lands on Revelation as REV 113
years.p: Eleven songs, The Wrath to Funeral Notice, with Half Empty and Undefeated carried over from the 7" and one called Rock and Roll Girl.
years.xp: Revelation pressed 250 copies on purple vinyl and 850 on black. The Bandcamp page dates the album to January 1, 2002, which may just be a placeholder.

years.p: Pitch Black turn up on the Revelation Records Sampler 2002 and again on the label's 2004 Collection (REV 110).

eras.title: Keyboards and a cowbell
eras.text: The second Revelation album added Jeremy Goody on keyboards and ran thirteen songs, with a two-part centerpiece and a closer called Executives and Art Directors.

years.h: This Is the Modern Sound opens on Tonopah
years.p: Thirteen songs, with Bronze Lady, Pt. 1 and Pt. 2 in the middle and Executives and Art Directors to close.
years.xp: Discogs credits Martin Munroe on bass, vocals and guitar, Kevin Cross on guitar, vocals and "propaganda", Jamie Morrison on drums and cowbell, and Jeremy Goody on keyboards. It is Revelation REV 124.

years.h: A third Revelation sampler, A Few Ditties From
years.p: Revelation puts Pitch Black on its 2005 sampler, Revelation Records Presents A Few Ditties From.
